title: Which part would you play?
sub: Six situations, and we'll tell you where you'd land in the cast. Not the name you'd be given — the person you'd be.
disclaimer: For fun. Six questions cannot know you, and the name at the bottom is one we liked for the part — not a reading of anything.

type.lead_direct: The camera finds you because you walked into the shot like it was yours. You say the line in episode two that anyone else would have saved for the finale.
type.lead_careful: You carry the story without ever raising your voice. Twelve episodes are spent waiting for the moment you finally do, and it lands because you made them wait.
type.firstLove_direct: You're the one who said it first, on a staircase, before either of you were ready. Whatever happens after, that scene is the one the show reruns.
type.firstLove_careful: You never quite said it, and that's why you're remembered in soft focus. Somebody is still holding the thing you handed them without explaining.
type.spark_direct: Two episodes of impossible timing and you'd just ask. The audience would scream. The writers would hate you for making it easy.
type.spark_careful: You and the other one keep arriving at the same door a minute apart. Nothing has been said, everyone can see it, and that is the entire genre.
type.second_direct: You tell them how you feel in episode eight and back off cleanly when they choose someone else. Half the audience switches to your side that night.
type.second_careful: You're the one who noticed they hadn't eaten. You'll never say the thing, and the forums will argue about you until the finale airs.
type.rival_direct: You arrive late, better dressed, and say the true thing nobody wanted said out loud. You are not wrong, which is the problem.
type.rival_careful: You don't compete; you simply keep turning out to have been right. By the time anyone notices you've been three scenes ahead all along.
type.bestie_direct: You carry every scene you're in and you weren't even supposed to be in half of them. Somebody has to shout the obvious thing, and it's you.
type.bestie_careful: You're the one who drives them home, remembers what they said in episode one, and never once makes it about you. They'd be lost, and they know it.

arrival.title: You walk into a room where you know one person.

options.catch: Go over to whoever just caught your eye.
options.centre: Head straight for the middle of it.
options.edge: Find the one person you know.
options.joke: Say something daft before anyone else speaks.

notice.title: Across the room, someone recognises you.

options.hold: Hold the look and don't glance away.
options.smile: Give them a small smile and leave it there.

rumour.title: A rumour about you is going round, and it is half true.

options.guess: Work out who started it, and why they would.
options.deny: Say flatly that it is not true.
options.shield: Let it run rather than drop anyone in it.
options.feed: Add a detail that makes it much better.

microphone.title: The microphone has been handed to you.

options.dedicate: Dedicate it to someone in the room.
options.sing: Sing it properly, all the way through.
options.pass: Pass it to whoever wants it more.

jealousy.title: Someone you like is laughing with someone else.

options.cut: Cut into the conversation and take it over.
options.wait: Wait for them to look up.
options.tease: Say something that makes them turn around.

umbrella.title: It's raining and there's one umbrella.

options.share: Share it, badly, getting half wet.
options.shelter: Wait it out under the awning.
options.give: Hand it over and turn your collar up.
options.run: Run for it and let the rain happen.

late.title: Your friend is an hour late and hasn't texted.

options.text: Send the message you have rewritten four times.
options.scold: Tell them exactly that when they arrive.
options.prank: Plan something ridiculous for when they walk in.

secret.title: You are holding something that is not yours to hold.

options.tell: Tell the one person it would change things with.
options.own: Say it out loud, to the room, now.
options.keep: Keep it, because telling it helps nobody.
options.deflect: Bury it under a joke and change the subject.

crossroads.title: Two doors, and the episode ends whichever you take.

options.chase: Go after the person, not the plan.
options.stand: Take the one that puts you in charge.

apology.title: Someone is owed an apology and it is yours to give.

options.first: Say it first, before they can ask.
options.face: Say it to their face, in front of everyone.
options.gift: Turn up with the thing they mentioned once.
options.joke2: Make them laugh, then say it quietly.

station.title: They are leaving in eleven minutes.

options.run2: Run. Work out the words on the way.
options.call: Call, and say it where anyone can hear.
options.write: Write it down and get it to them somehow.
options.watch: Watch the train go and mean it.

options.reunion: Running through a station to catch someone.
options.stare: One long look across a room, then the credits.
options.letter: A letter that arrives after you've gone.
options.toast: Everyone round one table, too loud, glasses up.

headline: The {temper} {role}
premise: Sixteen episodes. A city, a season about to turn, and a handful of people who keep ending up in the same rooms. Nobody has told you which one you are yet. That is what the next twelve scenes are for.

recap.seung_romance: Three scenes in and you have been looking at one person a beat longer than the shot needed. The show has noticed.
recap.seung_presence: You have taken up room in every scene so far. People move around you now, and the camera has started doing it too.
recap.seung_warmth: You keep being the one who checks. Nobody has thanked you for it yet, which is usually the sign it mattered.
recap.seung_mischief: Three scenes and you have already derailed two of them. The script is visibly getting nervous.
recap.jeon_romance: It has stopped being subtext. Whatever you do next, somebody is going to read it as an answer.
recap.jeon_presence: The room reorganises when you speak now. That is useful right up until the moment it is not.
recap.jeon_warmth: You have become the one people bring things to. It is a quiet kind of power and it is about to be tested.
recap.jeon_mischief: Nothing you touch has stayed where it was. The story has stopped planning around you and started planning with you.
recap.gyeol_romance: Everyone watching knows. The only question left is whether you say it out loud or let the rain do it.
recap.gyeol_presence: You are in the last act because you walked yourself here. Nobody handed you this scene.
recap.gyeol_warmth: You carried most of these people to the final episode. Whether anyone noticed is the thing still hanging.
recap.gyeol_mischief: You broke the shape of this drama three times and it is a better one for it. One scene left to ruin.
